title: Dane Groeneveld (CEO / Host, The Future of Teamwork podcast) — Eric on the Responsive stage: 'good companies slide into bad companies'
summary: Groeneveld is a founder and CEO who hosts The Future of Teamwork podcast. In a post from Responsive Conference he runs from Dart Lindsley's board exercise setting means against ends, on workplace language that reduces people to headcount, to Eric's turn on stage and Andre Martin on Zones of Genius.
blockquote:
Dart Lindsley led us through a great exercise at Work in Progress this week in the lead up to Responsive Conference 

Means ——————————— Ends 

…this is what he wrote on the board. 

In the simplest and shortest way of honoring the conversation we explored that language and mindset many use in the workplace treats humans as a means to an end (a means of production, headcount, assets, employees). 

Then Eric Ries came on stage to talk about incorruptible… and how good companies slide into bad companies.
